claims.claim: On the four Tier 3 boards, maniphys.ai improved: AUC rose from 0.10649 to 0.22590, SP-SR rose from 0.26666 to 0.33333, MP-SR rose from 0 to 0.10000, and MPPE fell from 54.98984 to 49.93762.
On the Tier 3 AUC board, maniphys.ai fell from 0.22590 to 0.10649.
Under the Kaggle tie rule maniphys.ai has a 12-board rank sum of 57 and is fourth, behind NVSimranPatil 38, Xueyi Wang (FF) 48 and nima arki 52.
maniphys.ai is first in the 12-board rank sum.
Of the lost Tier 3 episodes, 8 also fail in Tier 2 and include all 7 lost Tier 1 episodes; 9 are reconstruction problems, and ep3, 5, 10 and 14 are near misses.
Zero-residual replays of ep4, ep25 and ep1 still fail in every world at real-time playback, so speed is read as not the main cause.
Real-time playback made the zero-residual replays of ep4 succeed in most worlds.
The hard episodes do not saturate the residual more than the non-falling control ep23, whose waist saturates about 40% of the time, so the residual is read as not capped.
In the last two curriculum stages, 25% and then 50% of resets start at frame 0, like the evaluation.
Training never starts any episode at frame 0.
